videos.title: Lock 'n' Lock Storage
videos.description: Save Food, Save Space, Save Money - That's the philosophy behind Lock & Lock Storage, the unique storage system with the silicone seal and locking tabs to make your containers air and watertight. Dishwasher, freezer and microwave safe, Lock & Lock storage containers save food by sealing in the freshness to help you store your food for a longer time. Their unique, stackable design saves space in your cabinets, refrigerator and freezer. And Lock & Lock containers can save you money.
